user.title: Select Sesame 5 Device
user.description: Choose a discovered Sesame 5 smart lock from the list below, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

manual.title: Enter Device Details
manual.description: Please enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Sesame 5 device.

auth.title: Authenticate Smart Lock: {device_name}
auth.description:
Enter the Secret Key from your Sesame app.

[Real-time Persistent Connection (Recommended)]: Keeps BLE connected for instant status updates, unlock automations, and one-time passcode auto-deletion.
[Power-Saving Mode Limitations]: Connects only on-demand or periodically. Real-time manual unlock detection and instant one-time passcode deletion will be delayed or unavailable.
[Read-Only Mode]: Prevents remote lock and unlock operations.

data.history_tag: History Tag (Name shown in App log)
data.read_only: Read-only mode (Monitor state and battery only; disable remote operations)

auth_keypad.title: Authenticate Keypad: {device_name}
auth_keypad.description:
Enter the Secret Key from your Sesame app.

[Power-Saving Architecture]: Keypads do not use persistent long connection and only connect on demand to maximize battery life.
[Lock Binding]: Select the linked Sesame lock. When this lock is unlocked via password, the keypad will automatically connect and delete the one-time passcode immediately.
[Read-Only Mode]: Prevents adding or deleting passcodes via HA to avoid accidental modifications.

data.linked_lock: Linked Sesame Lock (for one-time passcode auto-deletion)
data.history_tag: History Tag (Name shown in App log)

no_devices.title: No Bluetooth Devices Found
no_devices.description:
Could not discover any nearby Sesame Bluetooth advertisements (already configured devices have been excluded).

Please check:
1. The device is within Bluetooth range and powered on.
2. If the device was idle or sleeping, wake it in the Sesame mobile app or tap the lock.

Would you like to manually enter a Bluetooth MAC address to attempt adding?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Sesame device via Bluetooth. Please ensure the device is within range.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify that your Secret Key or QR Code matches this device.
error.invalid_key_format: Unrecognized key format. Please provide a valid Sesame QR code URL or 16-byte key.

abort.already_configured: This Sesame device is already configured.
abort.bluetooth_not_available: No Bluetooth adapter or remote proxy configured. Home Assistant must have at least one Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy to connect to Sesame devices.

init.title: Sesame Smart Lock Options
init.description:
[Real-time Mode (Recommended)]: Maintains persistent BLE connection for instant state feedback, automations, and one-time passcode auto-deletion.
[Power-Saving Mode Limitations]: Disconnects after idle. Real-time physical unlock events cannot be pushed to HA until the next connection.
[Read-Only Mode]: Prevents remote unlock and lock operations.

data.refresh_interval: Periodic refresh interval in minutes (Power-Saving Mode only; 0 = on-demand)
data.history_tag: History Tag (Name shown in App unlock history)

keypad.title: Sesame Keypad Options
keypad.description:
[Power-Saving Architecture]: Keypads do not use persistent long connection and only connect on demand to maximize battery life.
[Lock Binding]: Select the linked Sesame lock. When this lock is unlocked via password, the keypad will automatically connect and delete the one-time passcode immediately.
[Read-Only Mode]: Prevents adding or deleting passcodes via HA to avoid accidental modifications.

data.linked_lock: Linked Sesame Lock (for one-time passcode auto-deletion)

add_passcode.name: Add Passcode
add_passcode.description: Add a passcode to a Sesame Touch / Keypad device (Touch 1/2 series). Supports temporary passcodes with an expiry duration and one-time passcodes. WARNING: Temporary expiry and one-time deletion are managed by Home Assistant via BLE. If the keypad is unreachable when the timer expires or when the door unlocks, deletion will fail. Also note that one-time passcodes auto-delete upon ANY keypad password unlock on the linked lock.

address.name: Bluetooth MAC Address
address.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the keypad (optional).

name.name: Passcode Name
name.description: Name or label for the passcode (e.g. Guest, Cleaner, Delivery).

duration.name: Duration (Seconds)
duration.description: Validity duration in seconds. Home Assistant automatically deletes this passcode when the timer expires. WARNING: Keypad must be in active Bluetooth range at expiration time to complete deletion; otherwise, the passcode will remain until manually deleted. Leave empty for permanent.

one_time.name: Auto-delete After One Use
one_time.description: Automatically delete passcode after first unlock. WARNING: Requires active Bluetooth connection between HA and keypad. Also note that ANY keypad password unlock on the linked lock triggers this deletion, because the lock protocol does not distinguish which passcode was entered.

delete_passcode.name: Delete Passcode
delete_passcode.description: Delete a specific passcode from a Sesame Touch / Keypad device by name or PIN digits.

address.name: Bluetooth MAC Address
address.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the keypad (optional).

name.name: Passcode Name
name.description: Name/label of the passcode entry to delete (from get_passcodes).

passcode.name: Passcode or Name
passcode.description: PIN digits (4 to 16 digits) or passcode name to delete.

get_passcodes.name: Get Passcode List
get_passcodes.description: Retrieve all registered passcodes from a Sesame Touch / Keypad device.

address.name: Bluetooth MAC Address
address.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the keypad (optional).
